Physical and Health Education

WEEK 1 - Moving Our Body Parts I

3. Fish              talk                      walk
Match the following to their movement -
4. Baby           Walk
3. Adult          Crawl
Match the following machines to their sound -
4. Train                  vroom, vroom
5. Motorcycle       veeeeee
6. Aeroplane         chiki chim, chiki chim

7. Lion
8. Horse
9. Chicken
10. Mosquito
